other_conditions: Must have secured admission in a course run by ITIs, Polytechnics, a school recognized by Central or State education Boards, a college affiliated to a recognized university, or training partners affiliated to NSDC/Sector Skill Councils/State Skill Mission/State Skill Corporation.
No collateral may be charged from the beneficiary.
benefits_summary: Provides interest-subsidised loans ranging from ₹5,000 to ₹1,50,000 for NSQF‑aligned skill courses, with repayment periods of 3 to 7 years and no collateral required.
documents_required: Proof of income (of self or guardian, if available)
application_link: Register on the Vidya Kaushal portal
